integrity: The complete open 1994 same-object PDF was inspected at its standard-map setup, invariant-measure and ergodic-average discussion, density-transport analysis, and conclusion, with full-document searches for covariance, variance, invariant measure, and average terminology. A 2000 standard-map statistical paper was compared through its publisher abstract. A 2013 mathematical standard-map paper was checked for statement-level implication and primary MSC classification. The stationary covariance law, variance inequality, equality affine relation, trigonometric resonance obstruction, and period-two conclusion were independently reconstructed, and the algebra was replayed with the packaged checker. The equality boundary was stress-tested against and exactly attained by the explicit two-cycle at \(K=2\pi\).
scientific_limitations: The result assumes compact momentum support on the cylinder and does not apply directly to unbounded accelerator-mode diffusion.
It gives first- and second-moment constraints, not existence or uniqueness of chaotic invariant measures.
The strict inequality requires nonzero kick variance; zero-kick invariant states are outside that strict statement.
The half-anticovariance algebra is generic for stationary additive increments; the standard-map-specific contribution is the kick realization and the full period-two equality rigidity.
Historical accounts trace the map to work before 1979, but the structured date uses the earliest checked day-resolved public source rather than inventing a day for older material.
An equivalent short equality-rigidity observation could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Exact kick–momentum covariance and two-cycle rigidity in the Chirikov standard map
